chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Abd al-Rahman from Safwan ibn Mihran said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Throwing [the Jamarat] is from the rising of the sun until its setting.'

key_terms.الرَّمْيُ: Throwing (specifically of stones at the Jamarat pillars)

ai.seo_question: What is the valid time for throwing the Jamarat during the days of Tashriq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines the specific window for the Jamarat ritual during the Days of Tashriq as extending from sunrise to sunset. This establishes the permissibility of performing the stoning at any time within this period, a view held by many Shia jurists, while also acknowledging the preferred times for spiritual reflection during the Hajj rites.
